summary: Retest of iteration_1 action item fix (full financial masking for izleyici role) plus re-run of all 7 prior backend tests + 7 browser checks. 16/16 artifacts passed (2 browser checks were flaky on first run due to a transient 429 rate-limit from running them in parallel, both passed clean on solo rerun).
action_items: Fixed a latent fixture-cleanup gap in izleyici-ui-hides-financials.mjs: it created tscheck-izleyici-ui-1@example.com but never deleted it, leaving a 4th user in the DB after prior runs (violates seed_facts requirement that only the 3 named users remain). Removed the leftover user via admin API and added an end-of-check API cleanup step to the persisted script so future reruns self-clean.
Removed a stray satis-role-restricted-buttons.mjs.backup file left in .emergent/scripts/checks/ from a prior session (not supposed to persist).
